name: PH Termine je Berater
query:
select
  ifnull(t.berater, 'ohne Berater') as `berater:Data:180`,
  t.modus as `modus:Data:110`,
  count(*) as `gesamt:Int:80`,
  sum(t.status = 'Bestaetigt') as `bestaetigt:Int:100`,
  sum(t.status = 'Erledigt') as `erledigt:Int:90`,
  sum(t.status = 'Nicht erschienen') as `nicht_erschienen:Int:130`,
  sum(t.status = 'Storniert') as `storniert:Int:90`,
  sum(t.status = 'Abgelehnt') as `abgelehnt:Int:90`,
  sum(t.quelle = 'website') as `website:Int:90`,
  round(100 * sum(t.status = 'Nicht erschienen') / nullif(sum(t.status in ('Erledigt', 'Nicht erschienen')), 0), 1) as `no_show_quote:Percent:110`,
  round(sum(case when t.status in ('Bestaetigt', 'Erledigt') then t.dauer_min else 0 end) / 60, 1) as `stunden:Float:90`
from `tabPH Termin` t
where t.start between %(von)s and concat(%(bis)s, ' 23:59:59')
  and (%(berater)s is null or %(berater)s = '' or t.berater = %(berater)s)
  and (%(modus)s is null or %(modus)s = '' or t.modus = %(modus)s)
group by t.berater, t.modus
order by t.berater, t.modus
